fact: External data fetch failures use retry attempts and, on exhaustion, return degraded stub payloads rather than failing the entire pipeline; this is implemented in pipeline/circuit_breaker.py as retry plus degraded stub fallback, not a classical open/half-open/closed circuit-breaker state model.
notes: File is named circuit_breaker.py but behavior is retry with degraded stubs.
limitations: Degraded stubs may reduce data completeness without halting the UI
